questions.stem: Gateways resend a day of features after an outage. The sink uses INSERT with a surrogate id. What happens and what fixes it?
options: Duplicates; upsert on (device, window_start) with a seq guard
questions.explanation: Redelivery is normal; the write must be idempotent on a natural key.

questions.stem: Which statement about Kafka transactions is correct?
options: They make writes to an external database exactly-once
They provide exactly-once between Kafka topics (read-process-write), not into your database
questions.explanation: EOS covers Kafka-to-Kafka; external sinks still need idempotency.

questions.stem: A 120 Hz tone sampled at 200 Hz appears at:
questions.explanation: Nyquist 100 Hz; 200 - 120 = 80 Hz.

questions.stem: You need 1 Hz resolution at fs = 10 kHz. Minimum FFT length?
questions.explanation: Resolution = fs / N, so N = 10,000 samples (1 s).

questions.stem: Which two are frequency-domain features? (choose two)
options: Band energy from a Welch PSD
questions.explanation: Crest factor and kurtosis are time-domain.

questions.stem: Your champion/challenger gate cannot find metrics for the challenger. It should:
options: Exit with an error and not move any alias (fail closed)
questions.explanation: Missing evidence is a reject.

questions.stem: Why is accuracy a poor gate metric for rare-fault detection?
questions.explanation: Use recall on faults and false alarms per machine-week.

questions.stem: INT8 accuracy is far below FP32 only after static quantization. First thing to check:
options: That calibration inputs match the runtime preprocessing and distribution
questions.explanation: Calibration on the wrong distribution is the classic failure.

questions.stem: Which execution provider would you try first on an Intel industrial PC with an iGPU?
questions.explanation: OpenVINO targets Intel CPUs, GPUs and NPUs.

questions.stem: p50 latency is 2 ms but p95 is 40 ms on the gateway. Likely causes? (choose two)
options: Thread oversubscription with the feature pipeline
Thermal throttling or CPU frequency scaling on the small board
questions.explanation: Tails come from contention and thermals; measure under the real load.

questions.stem: The canary device passes health checks but its alert rate is 8x the fleet baseline. The controller should:
options: Fail the canary on the model-metric gate and roll it back
questions.explanation: Health is necessary, not sufficient; model behaviour is a gate too.

questions.stem: Replay after an outage must not duplicate. Which two are required? (choose two)
options: An event id assigned at capture time
Server-side dedupe on that id and marking rows sent per acknowledged id
questions.explanation: Stable ids plus per-id acks make replay idempotent.

questions.stem: A previous engineer set PIP_TRUSTED_HOST to make pip work behind the proxy. Why is uv still failing and requests too?
options: uv and requests ignore pip settings; and verification was never fixed, only bypassed for pip
questions.explanation: Fix the trust store for every client instead of bypassing one.

questions.stem: Which variable does uv read for a custom CA file (with native TLS off)?
questions.explanation: uv honours SSL_CERT_FILE (or native-tls to use the system store).

questions.stem: Which control actually prevents an injected note from changing state?
options: Only read-only tools are dispatchable; writes need out-of-band human approval
questions.explanation: Enforcement is server-side.

questions.stem: The cloud fallback must never receive raw waveforms. How do you guarantee it?
options: Ask the cloud model not to request them
Build the cloud run without the raw-data tool and strip raw fields in code
questions.explanation: Do not offer or dispatch it; prove it in a test.

questions.stem: The CMMS returns 429 with Retry-After: 30. Your backoff says 2 s. Which wins?
options: 30 s (honour the server), within the retry budget
questions.explanation: Retry-After is the server's explicit instruction.

learn.label: Timeouts, retries and backoff with jitter

questions.stem: Two weeks into an 8-week engagement, what should exist?
options: A thin end-to-end slice on one machine, measured against the baseline
questions.explanation: Ship thin and measure, then widen.

learn.label: What are Forward Deployed Engineers? (The Pragmatic Engineer)

questions.stem: The controls engineer distrusts alarms after a failed vendor trial. Best design response?
options: Shadow mode with false alarms per machine-week as a signed metric before going live
questions.explanation: Make the fear a metric and let them sign it.

questions.stem: What is a 'defensible wedge' in FDE terms?
options: A customer-owned asset that solves the first problem well and makes the next engagement easier
questions.explanation: Value the client keeps and builds on.
